title: Replace tautological ConstrainedBox-ancestor check in r2_panel_leaf_crumb_ellipsis_test.dart with a real width-bound assertion
why: Empirically verified via mutation testing: with the real fix in place, `flutter test` passes 4/4. Reverting hierarchy_selection_panel.dart's leaf-crumb Text to a bare `Text(label)` (no overflow/maxLines/ConstrainedBox) makes the suite RED as expected — but reverting only the `ConstrainedBox(maxWidth: maxLeafCrumbWidth)` wrapper while leaving `overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis, maxLines: 1, softWrap: false` on the Text keeps all 4 cases GREEN. Instrumenting the finder shows why: it matches TextButton's own internal minimum-tap-target box (`ConstrainedBox(64.0<=w<=Infinity, 40.0<=h<=Infinity)`), not the fix's width cap. So a future regression that removes the actual width bound — exactly the failure mode the test's own `reason:` string names ("leaf crumb must be width-capped so ellipsis engages") — would ship undetected even though this file is tagged as the regression test for that bug.
recommendation: Assert on the rendered geometry instead of "any ConstrainedBox exists": either read the leaf Text's `RenderBox` size via `tester.getSize(find.byWidget(leaf))` and assert its width is bounded (e.g. <= panel width), or use `find.ancestor(matching: find.byWidgetPredicate((w) => w is ConstrainedBox && w.constraints.maxWidth < double.infinity))` so TextButton's own unrelated min-size box can't satisfy the finder.
acceptance_criteria: Re-running the test against a widget with the ConstrainedBox width-cap stripped (overflow/maxLines left in place) fails RED on the updated assertion.
All 4 parametrized LTR/RTL x scale cases stay GREEN with the real fix in place.
